V_kCAFG_culture_tension_minimum_for_modifier = 0.05 # Tension under this value will not have the province modifier effects

V_kCAFG_cultural_acceptance_tension_factor = 0.75 # 0% cultural acceptance will have this tension as a baseline

V_kCAFG_tradition_quarrelsome_baseline_tension_factor = 1.35
V_kCAFG_holder_tradition_ruling_caste_baseline_tension_factor = 0.8

V_kCAFG_cultural_emissary_baseline_culture_tension_reduction_max = 0.2

V_kCAFG_appease_cultural_tensions_decrease = 0.1

# Used by modifiers, how much tension is there relative to the province county
V_kCAFG_province_culture_tension_scaled_relative_amount_modifier = {
    value = V_kCAFG_province_culture_tension_scaled_relative_amount
    switch = {
        trigger = has_game_rule
		kCAFG_tension_effects_impact_025 = { multiply = 0.25 }
		kCAFG_tension_effects_impact_050 = { multiply = 0.50 }
		kCAFG_tension_effects_impact_075 = { multiply = 0.75 }
		kCAFG_tension_effects_impact_125 = { multiply = 1.25 }
		kCAFG_tension_effects_impact_150 = { multiply = 1.50 }
		kCAFG_tension_effects_impact_175 = { multiply = 1.75 }
		kCAFG_tension_effects_impact_200 = { multiply = 2 }
    }
}

# Used by modifiers, how much tension is there relative to the province county
# Returns value between 0-1
V_kCAFG_province_culture_tension_scaled_relative_amount = {
    value = var:kCAFG_culture_tension
    multiply = V_kCAFG_province_relative_values_scale
}

## Culture Tension Baseline for a specific culture
# Returns value between 0-1
# Scope : province
# Scopes :
# kCAFG_province
# kCAFG_culture
# kCAFG_target_culture
V_kCAFG_province_culture_tension_target_baseline_culture_contribution = {
    value = V_kCAFG_province_culture_factor
    multiply = scope:kCAFG_culture.V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline_complete
    max = 1
}

## Culture Tension Baseline for a specific culture
# Returns value between 0-1
# Scope : culture struct
# kCAFG_province
# kCAFG_target_culture
V_kCAFG_province_culture_tension_target_baseline_culture_struct_contribution = {
    value = var:factor
    multiply = var:tension_baseline
    max = 1
}

## Culture Tension Baseline for a specific culture
# Returns value between 0-1
# Scopes :
# kCAFG_target_culture
# province
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline_complete = {
    value = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:kCAFG_province }
        multiply = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline_holder_factor
    }
    max = 1
}

## Culture Tension Baseline for a specific culture
# Returns value between 0-1
# Scopes : culture
# kCAFG_target_culture
# province
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline = {
    value = 0

    # Inverted cultural acceptance
    add = {
        value = 1
        subtract = {
            value = "cultural_acceptance(scope:kCAFG_target_culture)"
            divide = 100 # no max value in defines or values ?
        }
        multiply = V_kCAFG_cultural_acceptance_tension_factor
    }
    
    multiply = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline_mult_VANILLA_B

    min = 0
    max = 1
}

# Scopes : culture
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline_mult_VANILLA_B = {
    value = 1

    if = {
        limit = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_quarrelsome }
        multiply = V_kCAFG_tradition_quarrelsome_baseline_tension_factor
    }
}

# Holder is taken into account
# Scope : culture
# kCAFG_target_culture
# province
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline_holder_factor = {
    value = 1

    scope:kCAFG_province.county.holder = {
        if = {
            limit = { knows_language_of_culture = prev }
            multiply = define:NCharacterOpinion|CULTURE_ACCEPTANCE_MULT_KNOWS_LANGUAGE
        }

        multiply = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline_holder_factor_mult_VANILLA_B
    }

    scope:kCAFG_province = {
        multiply = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_tolerance_law_factor
    }
}

# Scopes : character
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_target_baseline_holder_factor_mult_VANILLA_B = {
    value = 1

    if = {
        limit = { culture = { has_cultural_tradition = tradition_ruling_caste } }
        multiply = V_kCAFG_holder_tradition_ruling_caste_baseline_tension_factor
    }

    if = {
        limit = { has_court_position = cultural_emissary_court_position }
        multiply = {
            value = 1
            subtract = V_kCAFG_cultural_emissary_baseline_culture_tension_reduction_max
        }
    }

    # if = {
    #     limit = { exists = court_position:cultural_emissary_court_position }
	# 	court_position:cultural_emissary_court_position ?= {
    #         multiply = {
    #             value = 1
    #             subtract = {
    #                 value = aptitude:cultural_emissary_court_position # 0-4
    #                 divide = V_kCAFG_cultural_emissary_max_aptitude
    #                 multiply = V_kCAFG_cultural_emissary_baseline_culture_tension_reduction_max
    #             }
    #         }
    #     }
    # }
}

V_kCAFG_culture_tension_difference_from_target = {
    value = var:kCAFG_target_culture_tension
    subtract = var:kCAFG_culture_tension
}

V_kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_drift_factor = 0.075 # Tension will drift by this value multiplied by the difference with the baseline
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_drift_minimum_value = 0.005
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_drift_minimum_value_negative = {
    value = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_drift_minimum_value
    multiply = -1
}

# Scope : province
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_change = {
    value = 0
    add = {
        value = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_drift
        desc = kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_drift_tt
		format = "BREAKDOWN_FORMAT_PERCENTAGE_POSITIVE_IS_BAD_2_DECIMALS"
    }
}

V_kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_change_desc = {
    value = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_change
    save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_province
    add = {
        county.holder = {
            add = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_change_desc_warring_character
            every_liege_or_above = {
                add = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_change_desc_warring_character
            }
        }
        desc = kCAFG_culture_tension_on_lieges_warring_cultures_tt
        format = "BREAKDOWN_FORMAT_PERCENTAGE_POSITIVE_IS_BAD_2_DECIMALS"
    }
}

# Scope : character
# Required scope : kCAFG_province
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_change_desc_warring_character = {
    value = 0
    save_temporary_scope_as = warring_character
    if = {
        limit = {
            is_at_war = yes
            any_character_war = {
                primary_defender.culture != prev.culture
                using_conquest_cb_trigger = yes
                is_attacker = prev
                primary_defender.culture = {
                    save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_culture
                    scope:kCAFG_province = {
                        T_kCAFG_does_province_contain_culture = { CULTURE = scope:kCAFG_culture }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        ordered_character_war = {
            limit = {
                primary_defender.culture != prev.culture
                using_conquest_cb_trigger = yes
                is_attacker = prev
                primary_defender.culture = {
                    save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_culture
                    scope:kCAFG_province = {
                        T_kCAFG_does_province_contain_culture = { CULTURE = scope:kCAFG_culture }
                    }
                }
            }
            order_by = {
                value = 0
                casus_belli = {
                    every_target_title = {
                        if = { limit = { tier = tier_county } add = 1 }
                        else_if = { limit = { tier = tier_duchy } add = 5 }
                        else_if = { limit = { tier = tier_kingdom } add = 15 }
                        else_if = { limit = { tier = tier_empire } add = 50 }
                        else_if = { limit = { tier = tier_hegemony } add = 100 }
                    }
                }
            }
            primary_defender.culture = { save_temporary_scope_as = kCAFG_culture }
            casus_belli = {
                ordered_target_title = {
                    order_by = tier
                    max = 1
                    save_temporary_scope_as = highest_tiered_title # used by V_kCAFG_culture_tension_on_conquest_warring_quarterly
                }
            }
            scope:kCAFG_province = {
                add = {
                    value = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_on_conquest_warring_quarterly
                    multiply = {
                        value = 0.1
                        add = {
                            value = V_kCAFG_province_culture_factor
                            multiply = {
                                value = 1
                                subtract = 0.1
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    divide = 3 # Quarterly to monthly
                }
            }
        }
    }
}

# Scope : province
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_drift = {
    value = 0
    if = {
        limit = {
            OR = {
                V_kCAFG_culture_tension_difference_from_target > V_kCAFG_culture_tension_drift_minimum_value
                V_kCAFG_culture_tension_difference_from_target < V_kCAFG_culture_tension_drift_minimum_value_negative
            }
        }
        value = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_difference_from_target
        multiply = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_monthly_drift_factor
        if = {
            limit = { var:kCAFG_target_culture_tension > var:kCAFG_culture_tension }
            min = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_drift_minimum_value
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:kCAFG_target_culture_tension < var:kCAFG_culture_tension }
            max = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_drift_minimum_value_negative
        }
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { var:kCAFG_culture_tension != var:kCAFG_target_culture_tension }
        value = V_kCAFG_culture_tension_difference_from_target
    }
}


# Scope : province
# highest_tiered_title : title the war is targeting
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_on_conquest_declaration = {
    switch = {
        trigger = scope:highest_tiered_title.tier
        tier_county = { value = 0.1 }
        tier_duchy = { value = 0.2 }
        tier_kingdom = { value = 0.3 }
        tier_empire = { value = 0.4 }
        tier_hegemony = { value = 0.5 }
    }
}

# Scope : province
# highest_tiered_title : title the war is targeting
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_on_conquest_join = {
    switch = {
        trigger = scope:highest_tiered_title.tier
        tier_county = { value = 0.075 }
        tier_duchy = { value = 0.15 }
        tier_kingdom = { value = 0.225 }
        tier_empire = { value = 0.3 }
        tier_hegemony = { value = 0.375 }
    }
}

# Scope : province
# highest_tiered_title : title the war is targeting
V_kCAFG_culture_tension_on_conquest_warring_quarterly = {
    switch = {
        trigger = scope:highest_tiered_title.tier
        tier_county = { value = 0.02 }
        tier_duchy = { value = 0.04 }
        tier_kingdom = { value = 0.08 }
        tier_empire = { value = 0.14 }
        tier_hegemony = { value = 0.20 }
    }
}
